gloss: enjoying the evening cool; evening cool air

definitions.gloss: enjoying the evening cool; taking the evening air
definitions.explanation: The pleasant practice of going outside or sitting on a veranda in the evening to enjoy the cool air after a hot summer day. A seasonal word ({季語|きご}) associated with summer in Japanese poetry.

examples.japanese: {縁側|えんがわ}で{夜涼|よすず}みをする。
examples.english: To enjoy the evening cool on the veranda.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{夜涼|よすず}みに{花火|はなび}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: We enjoyed fireworks while taking the evening air in summer.

examples.japanese: {風鈴|ふうりん}の{音|おと}を{聞|き}きながら{夜涼|よすず}みをするのが{毎年|まいとし}の{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: Enjoying the evening cool while listening to wind chimes is something I look forward to every year.

notes:
A seasonal word ({季語|きご}) for summer in haiku and traditional poetry. Refers to the custom of stepping outside or sitting on a veranda ({縁側|えんがわ}) during summer evenings to escape the heat of the day and enjoy the cooler night air.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜涼|よすず}みをする: to enjoy the evening cool
- {夜涼|よすず}みに{出|で}る: to go out for the evening cool
- {夜涼|よすず}みがてら: while enjoying the evening cool

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally associated with summer evenings in Japan, when people would sit outside with {団扇|うちわ} (round fans) or {扇子|せんす} (folding fans), drink {麦茶|むぎちゃ} (barley tea), and enjoy the sounds of {風鈴|ふうりん} (wind chimes) or {虫|むし}の{声|こえ} (insect songs). The practice has become less common with the spread of air conditioning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {納涼|のうりょう}: enjoying the cool — broader term that includes daytime cooling activities and organized events like {納涼|のうりょう}{大会|たいかい} (summer cooling festivals)
